answer: A sybil tax blocks forged identities: each new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 20 POA tax before acting. Honest history works like an orchard, each clean epoch cutting the renewal tax by 2 POA, so a genuine agent's burden fades. A forger's bill spirals upward: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 POA, sunk forever, and a caught identity pays the full tax again, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back in two epochs of real work.
